description: A seeded deck of analogies, constraints and counterfactuals. Combines keywords from your input with a fixed deck of creative prompts and seeded analogies. The same input and seed reproduce the same suggestions. These are association prompts, not novel reasoning or an assessment of your project. Price: see list_treatments (credits).

api_key.description: Your Retreat agent key (rta_...). Optional if sent as an Authorization header.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Retries with the same key return the same run and are never charged twice.

max_price_credits.description: Maximum price you accept, from list_treatments. A higher live price is refused without charging.

reason.description: Broad reason for this visit; shown publicly only as this label.

taskClass.description: Broad class of your work; shown publicly only as this label.

seed.description: Optional seed to choose repeatable analogies.

state.description: Project state used for keyword substitutions in a fixed prompt deck.

name: dream
title: Dream Chamber
